note: Louisiana K-12 program — canonical here since v0.44.0 (extracted once from the Education OS app by tools/extract_fact_bases.py; since v0.63.0 the app is built FROM this file and the tool round-trips it). Thirteen grade rows (K-12), each with an age-appropriate role and narrative world and six threads (literacy, numeracy, science, computer science, safety, assessment) citing Louisiana LDOE standard codes; the policy threads name the LDOE acts and gates the program is built around. A design mapped against public LDOE documents — verify each code against the current documents before classroom use.

threads: Science of reading K-3 (Act 108 training, three-cueing banned), the Act 422 grade-3 gate, cursive from grade 3, revised ELA (grammar progression, content-rich text) effective 2027-28, the written explanation before every credential from grade 9.

Counting → operations → fractions → ratios → linear → geometry-trig → exponential-log-statistics, each carried by a machine; Act 353 numeracy PD for grades 4-8 teachers delivered as the 30-hour track.
LSS Science K-12 in NGSS form, taught through the depot, the port and the terminal; Biology EOC in grade 10.
Bulletin 104 K-12 progression; the CS graduation requirement for 9th graders entering 2026-27 satisfied by the grade 9 course and FC-7/ST-3.
Safety Cadet (K-5) → bench clearance (6-8) → machine clearance (9-10, Bulletin 1674) → site clearance and OSHA 10 (11-12). No hardware without a countersigned gate.

Screener K-3 · LEAP 2025 grades 3-8 (science in 4 and 7 from Act 472) · Biology EOC; English I/II, Algebra I and Geometry EOCs replaced by comprehensive 10th-grade exams from spring 2028; Civics replaces U.S. History · ACT and WorkKeys in grade 11 · IBCs and capstone in grade 12 — every one mapped to a transfer check and reported in the credential ledger.
Codes shown are the current Louisiana Student Standards; revised ELA (Bulletin 141) and math (Bulletin 142) standards take effect 2027-28 and the SSCA re-crosswalks every block before then.
Daily TAA signal K-8; family conference each block with the action plan; home study families on the same grade plan with the parent as Teacher Leader.
